arguments.sql: SELECT customers.name AS "Cliente", SUM(order_lines.quantity * products.unit_price) AS "Importo" FROM orders JOIN order_lines ON orders.id = order_lines.order_id JOIN products ON order_lines.product_id = products.id JOIN customers ON orders.customer_id = customers.id WHERE customers.country = 'DE' AND orders.order_date BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-12-31' GROUP BY customers.name;
